title: Harbor Light world — Soft Hour glossary
lede: Spoiler-light entity map for readers and assistants. Dark mafia romance by Picu Bianca-Maria — loyalty is currency; love has no ledger line.

entries.name: Elena Voss
entries.summary: Heir of House Voss. Dark eyes. Counts locks, clauses, and exits. Forced into an arranged marriage pact with the Obsidian Coven — she reads the trap before she signs.

entries.name: Julian Kane
entries.summary: Shadow Hand of the Obsidian Coven. Steel eyes. Twelve years without a public failure. Morally grey MMC — protocol first, devotion that costs.

entries.name: Obsidian Coven
entries.summary: Harbor syndicate power. Patriarch at the top; Shadow Hand enforcement; marriage pacts and district absorption as administrative weapons.

entries.name: Harbor Light (city)
entries.summary: Misted harbor city where loyalty is currency. Ward-stone rooms, berths, docks, and paper that moves faster than knives.

entries.name: Quiet List
entries.summary: Ledger mark / pressure system. Charges written as corporate language. Refusal can mean berths — or invisibility.

entries.name: Glass Holding
entries.summary: Corporate-facing Holding power inside the empire. Stamps, pharmacy routes, loyalty seals, and paperwork that prices mercy.

entries.name: Soft Hour
entries.summary: Not a romance backdrop — a basement triage floor under empire. Care as leverage. On this site, Cinematic Soft Hour also names the Gumroad audio format (SFX + score).

entries.name: Soft Gate
entries.summary: Holding converts sealed medical history into a weapon. Named without spoiling the full mechanism — revealed in-story.

entries.name: The Patriarch
entries.summary: Doesn't ask — draws the contract. Wants the Voss name and the appearance of continuity in the harbor districts.

entries.name: Corvus
entries.summary: Surveillance / enforcement network under Coven hierarchy. Procedural pressure and watch posts around Elena and Julian.
